dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: Heh, even though we've already gone through all the motions of the Rite of Parting, I still don't really believe that the Lord of Geo is dead.

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: If you ask me, this whole thing is just a big scheme by the Qixing. They're undoubtedly the ones pulling all the strings behind the scenes.

dialogues.speaker: Big-Footed Dajiao
dialogues.text: ... Well, that's my two cents, at least. But don't you go around telling everybody what I think now, ya hear?
